name: omp-sessions
description: A task server for oh-my-pi (omp) coding agents: background sessions with a task queue each, scheduled starts and a global concurrency limit, locally or over Remote-SSH. Sessions keep running with no client open; drive them from VS Code, the omp-sessions terminal command, your phone or Hermes Agent. In VS Code: open any session with the full chat, run parallel git-worktree sessions, track every session on a kanban board, and review or revert native diffs.
author: Manel Baradad <manelbaradad@gmail.com>

untrustedWorkspaces.description: omp is a coding agent: it runs shell commands, edits files and loads project configuration (AGENTS.md, .omp/) from the folder, and the extension starts sessions through the AO daemon. Trust the folder to use it.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Sessions run omp as a process on the file system of the extension host; virtual file systems are not reachable from it.

omp.showTodayCost.description: Show today's omp spend (from session transcripts) in the status bar. Hidden on days without model calls.

omp.dashboard.includeTerminalSessions.description: Usage dashboard and today's spend also count omp sessions run without omp Sessions, e.g. plain omp in a terminal (all transcripts under ~/.omp/agent/sessions).

omp.snapshotRetentionDays.markdownDescription: Days a stopped session must be unused before **omp: Clean Up File Snapshots** (and the Doctor report) offers to delete its file snapshots (the blobs behind change diffs and reverts).

omp.extraArgs.description: Extra omp CLI arguments for every omp session on this machine, from any client, e.g. ["--profile", "work"]. Mirrored to ~/.switchyard/config.json and applied by the Switchyard omp shim when AO launches omp. Can't be set per workspace.

omp.vscodeTools.markdownDescription: Lets omp sessions started in a terminal read your open VS Code windows' language data (diagnostics, symbols, definitions, references, implementations, call hierarchy, hover and signature docs, the active editor's file and selection: **read-only**) through the VS Code bridge. Off: sessions start without the VS Code tools, and the bridge's local socket is not served. Can't be set per workspace.

enumDescriptions: Inject the message into the running turn.
Queue the message to run after the current turn.
omp.sendWhileBusy.description: What Enter does while the agent is working.

enumDescriptions: Open chats as editor tabs (several side by side).
Open chats in the omp Chat view (move it to the secondary side bar to keep it next to your code).
omp.chatLocation.description: Where clicking a session opens its chat.

enumDescriptions: Group sessions under their project (git repository, else folder).
Your custom groups and sub-groups; ungrouped sessions at the bottom.
By status: needs input, working, idle, stopped.
omp.groupBy.description: How the Sessions view organizes sessions.

enumDescriptions: Manual order when grouped by custom groups, else last activity.
Your order: Move Up/Down or drag & drop.
Next scheduled queue start first; unscheduled sessions last.
Marked completed first (latest first), then the most recently finished.
omp.sortBy.description: How sessions are sorted within each group of the Sessions view.

omp.server.autoStart.markdownDescription: When VS Code opens, start the per-user planner (it runs task queues, dependencies and schedules with no client open) and, when none runs, the Agent Orchestrator daemon that runs every omp session (`ao daemon`, found through `~/.ao/running.json`). Off: nothing is started; the status bar shows when AO is unreachable and **omp: Start Planner and AO Daemon** starts both.

omp.server.installService.markdownDescription: Run the planner and the AO daemon as user services the first time they start (systemd user units, a launchd agent for the planner), so they come back after a crash or reboot. Off: they still start on demand but not at login; AO then runs as a detached process. The planner service is never installed for VS Code's own runtime (no Node 22+ on PATH): it moves with VS Code updates.

enumDescriptions: Sessions whose folder is a workspace folder or inside one (any status).
Every omp session on this machine.
omp.sessionScope.description: Which sessions the Sessions view, Tasks view, Sessions Board and status bar list. A window without folders lists all sessions.

omp.saveBeforePrompt.description: Save unsaved editors inside the session folder before sending a prompt, so omp sees what you see.

omp.notifications.description: Notify when a session finishes or needs input while its chat is not visible.

omp.notifyAllSessions.markdownDescription: Notify about every omp session on this machine, including those started from `omp-sessions`, the phone app or Hermes in folders this window doesn't have open. Off: only sessions in this window's workspace folders.

omp.sound.completion.markdownDescription: Sound when a session finishes its turn (the cues of Hermes Desktop; **None**: silent). It plays in an open omp chat or the Sessions Board, on the computer you run VS Code on, for the sessions `omp.notifyAllSessions` covers; with several omp chats or windows open only one plays it. Listen to them all with **omp: Test Completion Sound**.

omp.sound.input.markdownDescription: Sound when a session needs input (a question or approval); **None**: silent. Same rules as `omp.sound.completion`.

omp.sound.volume.markdownDescription: Volume of the session sounds, 0–1 (1: Hermes Desktop's level, 0: silent).

omp.showChangeDecorations.description: Mark files changed by omp sessions in the Explorer and show their changed lines (gutter + CodeLens with diff/revert) in editors.

omp.hermes.dashboardUrl.markdownDescription: Hermes Agent dashboard that **Open Hermes Card** opens (its Kanban page) for sessions started by the Hermes kanban lane. Empty: the dashboard Hermes records as running on the machine omp runs on (any port), else `http://localhost:9119`. In a remote window a `localhost` address is forwarded to your machine.

omp.chat.toolCardsCollapsed.description: Show tool cards collapsed in the chat (edits and questions always start open). Alt+T or the chat menu collapses/expands all.

name.description: Completion name: type /p:<name> in the composer.

prompt.description: Text inserted into the composer. {{selection}} and {{file}} are replaced with the active editor's selection and path.

omp.chat.snippets.markdownDescription: Prompt snippets offered in the chat composer as `/p:<name>`. Markdown files in the session folder's `.omp/prompts/` are added too (file name = snippet name, optional `description:` front matter). `{{selection}}` and `{{file}}` are filled in from the active editor.

omp.terminalHints.description: After a command fails in a terminal inside a running session's folder, show "omp: fix failed command?" in the status bar for 15 seconds. (Fix Failed Command with omp works either way; needs VS Code shell integration.)

omp.voice.name.markdownDescription: Voice of voice mode (the microphone button in the chat). Voice mode is omp's realtime voice: it runs on the machine omp runs on and uses OpenAI's realtime model through a ChatGPT login (`/login`). Empty: omp's `live.voice` setting.
